new_entries.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point Security Management: pre-authentication path traversal to arbitrary script upload/execution, exploited as a zero-day since July
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(b): actively exploited zero-day (pinpointed attacks since 2026-07-23) on internet-facing management infra with no LivePatch available; CISA KEV 2026-09-22.

new_entries.title: CVE-2026-93952 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: actively exploited, two release trains still unpatched
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(b): confirmed active exploitation of SD-WAN control-plane infra; 6.1.x/7.0.x trains have no fix at all as of 2026-09-22; CISA KEV 2026-09-22.

new_entries.title: CVE-2026-94127 — F5 BIG-IP APM: unauthenticated heap overflow in OAuth-profile processing reaches RCE on the TMM data plane
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(b): F5-confirmed active exploitation, unauthenticated network-only RCE on an authentication-gateway component; CISA KEV 2026-09-22.

new_entries.title: EU Court of Auditors: cyber-incident cooperation framework only partially effective, cross-border notification failed for 2025 airport ransomware disruption
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(c): changes how Swiss GovCERT/public-sector defenders should weight direct primary-source monitoring vs. relying on EU cross-notification for early warning.

new_entries.title: Austria's NISG 2026 creates the Bundesamt für Cybersicherheit, 24h/72h reporting clock live 1 October 2026
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(c): DACH-neighbour NIS2 transposition comparator directly relevant to Swiss cantonal/federal cybersecurity-law design (Canton Bern ICSG parallel).

new_entries.title: NCSC Switzerland: Google recovery-address abuse plus a Sites-hosted phishing page plants an OAuth app-password backdoor that survives a password reset
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(d): genuine identity-persistence technique (app-password bypassing MFA, surviving password rotation) from the authoritative Swiss national CERT; consumer-facing framing but transferable detection/hardening lesson for any Google Workspace deployment.

new_entries.title: Open-source AI pentesting harnesses (Strix, Cairn, Hermes) run an autonomous intrusion-and-skimmer campaign against online retailers for about $25 a target
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(d): fully reconstructed, transferable web-app attack chain (SQLi->MFA bypass->file upload RCE->sudo misconfig->NFS pivot->secrets exposure->DB key extraction) plus a significant entity-graph link (Hermes AI agent reused across three unrelated operator classes, two of them state-nexus).

new_entries.title: Virtualizor VPS/hypervisor control panel: a login-page guard's own exemption for act=login lets an unauthenticated attacker reach root
new_entries.rationale: PD-11(b) 'otherwise' limb: anonymous path to full root administrative control of internet-facing hosting infrastructure; patch diff hands over the technique. No confirmed ITW exploitation -> high not critical.

updates.rationale: PD-13: KEV addition moves CVE-2026-85102 from not-confirmed-exploited to confirmed-exploited (exploitation wave against Spark customers since 2026-09-12). Floats entry; priority high->critical.

CERT Polska's own new technical write-up corrects the chain's entry-point CVE (CVE-2026-67276 wrongly attributed; real entry point is CVE-2026-67279 SSH rekey-during-auth state confusion) and supplies a materially different mechanism for CVE-2026-67279 than this entry currently describes. Requires a fresh deep-read of the CERT Polska primary before composing given the sensitivity of overturning previously-quoted primary text. Does not float (correction).
